main_issue: Whether and when Agent D can cook strong-smelling food (devil curry) given smell affecting laundry and living room; settled on Saturday and Sunday.

A-B.evidence: B asks A what would work (T16) and A answers with Saturday (T17); B's window/hood idea was never taken up by A, and B did not state a final position on the Sat/Sun deal.

A-C.evidence: A proposes Saturday (T17), C says Saturday works (T19); A says Sunday fine (T21), C says Sunday fine too (T23).

A-D.evidence: A first asked for no strong-smelling cooking and rejected Tue/Fri (T15); D then accepted A's Saturday (T20); A accepted Sunday (T21); D concluded 'Saturday and Sunday it is' (T24).

B-C.evidence: C rejected B's hood idea (T9, T11); B said 'better than nothing' (T10); later C agreed to weekends, B silent.

B-D.evidence: B proposed hood/window (T8); D pursued scheduling instead; B never commented on the final Sat/Sun deal.

C-D.evidence: C rejected notice-before-cooking (T5); D dropped it and proposed days (T6, T12); C asked which days (T13), agreed to Saturday (T19) and Sunday (T23); D confirmed (T24).
